_comment: Xalvyr Tenn, dark elf copyist of the Sandveil Bazaar (Scripts/talking_vendor_npc.gd; placed in lumora_outskirts3d.tscn). Sells the spell and skill scrolls of the dark classes — Voidknight, Gravecaller, Shadowblade, Chaosborn (Data/vendor_shop.json 'lumora_scribe_dark'). A Shadowfen outsider in a town openly hostile to Shadowfen; tolerated only under Zyra Sandveil's protection. Smooth, amoral, amused: 'Coin acknowledges no gods.' {word} in a line is a clickable keyword. ALL LINES ARE DRAFTS for the user to change.
greeting: Ah. You found me. Most people pretend not to see the stall.
Welcome. Whatever the {Wardens} told you about me, it is probably true. It is also irrelevant.
Come closer. The ink does not bite. Well. Not all of it.
shop_intro: Copies of things the archive will not keep. Accurate copies. I take pride in that much.
Coin acknowledges no gods. Neither do these pages.
Void rites, grave-songs, shadow work, a little chaos. Nothing you cannot handle. Probably.
ambient: The archivist glares at me every morning. I have started waving back.
Lumora hates Shadowfen. Lumora also buys from Shadowfen. I find that very restful.
Knowledge is only dangerous to the people who do not have it.
Another guard asked where I am from. I told him the bazaar. It is true enough.
{Zyra} says I am good for business. Zyra is rarely wrong about business.
secret: At night, the dunes sing. Where I come from, the dark sings back.
I have copied texts that asked to be finished. I did not finish them. Not yet.
The Moribund Order pays very well for some pages. I tell them I have never heard of those pages.

lines: Take your time. The pages are patient. I am less so.
Ilsabet keeps the Wardens' pretty texts and refuses the rest. Someone has to keep the rest. Someone might as well be paid for it.
Zyra Sandveil keeps me alive in a town that would rather I were not. I keep her ledgers balanced. We understand each other.
Shadowfen? I left. Shadowfen did not notice. Lumora noticed immediately.
